Weekly watch-hour quota anchored on the instant access was granted, with per-session watch history a student can audit

name: Referral Credit Ledger
kicker: Earn, spend and send credits — exact under concurrency
summary: One credit ledger replacing the academy's old points scheme. Students earn credits only from money that actually settled, spend them on watch passes, subscriptions and course instalments, and send them to friends by referral code — built to stay exact under replayed webhooks, racing workers and simultaneous transfers.
role: Sole author across the ERP and both student dashboards — 13 merged PRs, 1,100+ automated tests.
impact: Launched 26 Sep 2026 — 3,600+ students credited on day one through an idempotent backfill of past purchases
Insert-once ledger with a unique dedupe key plus an hourly reconcile sweep — every settlement lands on exactly one row
Peer-to-peer transfers lock both wallets in a fixed order with idempotency keys and jittered deadlock retry — 48/48 clean under concurrent stress
Two-level referral rewards plus workshop and trial earnings — refunds and rollbacks claw credits back automatically
Per-product spend caps, up to 100% on premium courses, enforced under a per-student wallet lock with holds and debts
Red-team concurrency and security suites; every rule sits behind a Desk kill switch

name: AI Voice Lead Qualification
kicker: Every new lead, called by AI within seconds
summary: A new sales lead lands in the CRM and an AI voice agent calls them within seconds, interviews them in Tamil-English, captures a structured qualification profile live during the call and routes hot leads to humans — then hands its verdict to Meta so the ads optimise on it.
role: Feature author and owner, end-to-end — 70+ commits, ~460 automated tests. Python / Frappe.
impact: 6,900+ AI calls placed to 1,300+ leads since July 2026
Six verdicts — Hot, Warm, Cold, Callback, Disqualified, Incomplete — with 11 structured profile fields
The assistant reports the qualification itself mid-call, and a signed end-of-call webhook resolves each call instantly — polling stays as the fallback
Found and removed a lock-ordering race that double-dialled leads — one lead, one call
Outage recovery re-queues every lead from the exact attempt it lost; a nightly no-call window and comment-driven Do-Not-Call keep it courteous
Meta bids on the AI's same-day verdict — about 4× more optimisation signal than the old sales-status event

name: Syllabi AI → LearnAI
kicker: A university syllabus PDF becomes a personal AI course, with hands-on labs
summary: Syllabi AI turns a university curriculum PDF into a browsable tree — programme and regulation down to courses and units — on labs.selfmade.ninja. From any unit, a student opens LearnAI, the platform's AI tutor, pre-filled with that unit's topics: it writes a module-and-chapter lesson grounded in the syllabus, streams each chapter live, recommends hands-on cloud labs, and answers questions through a chat tutor that can run commands inside the student's own lab.
role: Designed and built Syllabi AI v1 end to end — the agentic parsing backend and the web UI, 35 commits and ~9k lines — plus LearnAI's lab-recommendation agents. Most of today's parser code is still mine; the wider team built LearnAI's core and extended the syllabus module.
impact: Five specialized agents with Pydantic-typed outputs — syllabus, flat-syllabus, unit, web-unit and lab-experiment extraction
Scanned PDFs rescued by an OCR fallback; link-index syllabi switch to flat mode and fetch every matched Google Drive document concurrently
SHA-256 file dedup plus a campus + programme + regulation check — a syllabus is never parsed, or paid for, twice
Deterministic IDs make every re-parse an upsert, and old data is kept until a new parse actually produces courses
Built for real curricula — three syllabi alone yielded 296 courses and 1,556 units
LearnAI lessons carry the unit, its sibling units and related lessons as context, stream chapter by chapter, and link back to the syllabus
